account.experience: I constructed a two-step behavior by demonstrating fire-clay and seed-water, teaching their actual traces, composing them at east-flowing A2, and installing the pair. The maker fired C3 before rooting B3, preserving local B while upstream roots fragmented arriving B. This is a demonstrated local procedure with autonomous targeting and walking; my decisions specified operations, footprint and order rather than selecting a finished goal.
noticedResponses: Fire at C1 captured A before upstream roots fragmented arrivals.
Seed at B1 also grew a descendant at D1.
The maker translated the linked footprint to C3/B3, captured B rather than copying A, then grew B3 and descendant D3.
The maker needed separate walking beats through the dry middle row.
account.narrativeOrConceptThatMattered: A remembered island inside a living river: maintain a local exact identity within softened, fragmented flow.
account.closure: Externally interrupted by the user overnight stop after the second primitive enacted. This is not a voluntary stop, boredom, failed long-target evidence, or elective closure.
account.nextIntention: If resumed, first checkpoint this completed initial episode, then decide honestly whether the archive-and-living-river creation suggests another project. I had not yet made that stop-or-continue decision.
account.repetition: Five wait actions so far mostly observed deterministic maker travel and execution; no repeated intervention loop.
account.technicalProblems: An attempted progress message to root was blocked by a collaboration tool automatic review as suspected exfiltration/lateral movement. No gameplay command failed except an initial uppercase action filter returning zero results and help invocation returning usage; lowercase public action inspection resolved that.

report.experience: Constructed a demonstrated two-operation procedure, then observed its autonomous translation and locally different memory. Thoughtful part was firing before upstream roots fragment the identity; teaching and waiting were procedural overhead.
report.noticedResponses: C1 retained A under fragmented A arrivals; transferred fire then seed made C3 retain B under fragmented B, with roots at B3 and D3. No A identity was copied.
report.closure: Externally interrupted by user overnight stop at 11 actions, before checkpoint or elective stop-or-continue decision. No voluntary closure or long-target verdict.
report.renewedIntention: Undecided; next intended protocol step was a checkpoint for the completed initial creation before honestly choosing further play.
report.repetition: 6 player combinations and 5 waits; 2 maker combinations; no finish. One intended episode has its physical result.
report.interruption: User explicitly requested overnight handoff; gameplay stopped immediately.
